mapper.select: ( SELECT 'answer' AS type, CAST(answer_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, question_title AS title, SUBSTRING(content, 1, 200) AS snippet, author_name AS authorName, '/view/zhihu/answer/' AS linkPrefix, created_time AS time FROM zhihu_answer WHERE question_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'article' AS type, CAST(article_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, title AS title, SUBSTRING(content, 1, 200) AS snippet, author_name AS authorName, '/view/zhihu/article/' AS linkPrefix, created_time AS time FROM zhihu_article WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'pin' AS type, CAST(pin_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, '想法' AS title, SUBSTRING(content, 1, 200) AS snippet, author_name AS authorName, '/view/zhihu/pin/' AS linkPrefix, created_time AS time FROM zhihu_pin WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'comment' AS type, CAST(c.target_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT('评论 @', c.author_name) AS title, SUBSTRING(c.content, 1, 200) AS snippet, c.author_name AS authorName, CASE c.target_type WHEN 1 THEN '/view/zhihu/answer/' WHEN 2 THEN '/view/zhihu/article/' WHEN 3 THEN '/view/zhihu/pin/' END AS linkPrefix, c.created_time AS time FROM zhihu_comment c WHERE c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY c.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'guba_post' AS type, CAST(post_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, title AS title, SUBSTRING(content, 1, 200) AS snippet, author_name AS authorName, '/view/guba/post/' AS linkPrefix, publish_time AS time FROM guba_post WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'guba_comment' AS type, CAST(c.post_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT('股吧评论 @', c.author_name) AS title, SUBSTRING(c.content, 1, 200) AS snippet, c.author_name AS authorName, '/view/guba/post/' AS linkPrefix, c.publish_time AS time FROM guba_comment c WHERE c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY c.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'ai_analysis' AS type, CAST(a.target_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT('AI分析 (', a.analysis_type, ')') AS title, SUBSTRING(a.result, 1, 200) AS snippet, a.ai_model AS authorName, CASE a.target_type WHEN 'answer' THEN '/view/zhihu/answer/' WHEN 'article' THEN '/view/zhihu/article/' WHEN 'pin' THEN '/view/zhihu/pin/' WHEN 'post' THEN '/view/guba/post/' END AS linkPrefix, a.created_time AS time FROM ai_analysis a WHERE a.result LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND a.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY a.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) ORDER BY time DESC

choose.when: SELECT question_title AS title, author_name AS authorName, created_time AS time FROM zhihu_answer WHERE answer_id = #{targetId} LIMIT 1
SELECT title, author_name AS authorName, created_time AS time FROM zhihu_article WHERE article_id = #{targetId} LIMIT 1
SELECT SUBSTRING(content, 1, 50) AS title, author_name AS authorName, created_time AS time FROM zhihu_pin WHERE pin_id = #{targetId} LIMIT 1
SELECT title, author_name AS authorName, publish_time AS time FROM guba_post WHERE post_id = #{targetId} LIMIT 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS title, NULL AS authorName, NULL AS time FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( ( SELECT 'answer' AS type, CAST(a.answer_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, a.question_title AS title, SUBSTRING(a.content, 1, 200) AS snippet, a.author_name AS authorName, '/view/zhihu/answer/' AS linkPrefix, a.created_time AS time, 'zhihu' AS source FROM zhihu_answer a
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC LIMIT 1000 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'article' AS type, CAST(a.article_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, a.title AS title, SUBSTRING(a.content, 1, 200) AS snippet, a.author_name AS authorName, '/view/zhihu/article/' AS linkPrefix, a.created_time AS time, 'zhihu' AS source FROM zhihu_article a
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC LIMIT 1000 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'pin' AS type, CAST(p.pin_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, '想法' AS title, SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 200) AS snippet, p.author_name AS authorName, '/view/zhihu/pin/' AS linkPrefix, p.created_time AS time, 'zhihu' AS source FROM zhihu_pin p
ORDER BY p.created_time DESC LIMIT 1000 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'guba_post' AS type, CAST(g.post_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, g.title AS title, SUBSTRING(g.content, 1, 200) AS snippet, g.author_name AS authorName, '/view/guba/post/' AS linkPrefix, g.publish_time AS time, 'guba' AS source FROM guba_post g
ORDER BY g.publish_time DESC LIMIT 1000 ) ) AS combined ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
